# pcd Provider

Interact with Platform9 Private Cloud Director (PCD). The provider authenticates to Keystone v3 and talks to the OpenStack services PCD exposes (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone) plus PCD-specific services (resmgr, hamgr, mors).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pcd = {
      source = "platform9/pcd"
    }
  }
}

provider "pcd" {
  auth_url    = "https://pcd.example.com/keystone/v3"
  region      = "Infra"
  user_name   = "admin@example.localnet"
  password    = var.pcd_password
  tenant_name = "service"

  user_domain_id    = "default"
  project_domain_id = "default"

  # Community Edition uses a self-signed certificate.
  insecure = true
}

variable "pcd_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Confirms authentication end to end.
data "pcd_identity_auth_scope" "current" {
  name = "current"
}

output "authenticated_user" {
  value = data.pcd_identity_auth_scope.current.user_name
}

output "project" {
  value = data.pcd_identity_auth_scope.current.project_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_reauth` (Boolean) Re-authenticate automatically when a token expires mid-operation. Defaults to true.
- `application_credential_id` (String) Application credential ID. Falls back to `OS_APPLICATION_CREDENTIAL_ID`.
- `application_credential_name` (String) Application credential name. Falls back to `OS_APPLICATION_CREDENTIAL_NAME`.
- `application_credential_secret` (String, Sensitive) Application credential secret. Falls back to `OS_APPLICATION_CREDENTIAL_SECRET`.
- `auth_url` (String) Keystone v3 auth URL, e.g. `https://pcd.example.com/keystone/v3`. Falls back to `OS_AUTH_URL`.
- `cacert_file` (String) Path to a custom CA certificate bundle (PEM). Falls back to `OS_CACERT`.
- `cert` (String) Path to a client certificate (PEM) for mutual TLS. Falls back to `OS_CERT`.
- `cloud` (String) Name of a `clouds.yaml` entry to source configuration from. Falls back to `OS_CLOUD`. **Not yet implemented in this pre-release** — use explicit `auth_url`/credentials for now.
- `endpoint_overrides` (Map of String) Map of Keystone service type to endpoint URL, overriding the catalog (escape hatch for labs).
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification (required for CE's self-signed cert). Falls back to `OS_INSECURE`.
- `key` (String) Path to the client private key (PEM) for mutual TLS. Falls back to `OS_KEY`.
- `max_retries` (Number) Number of times to retry on transient (429/5xx) errors.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for password auth. Falls back to `OS_PASSWORD`.
- `project_domain_id` (String) Domain ID of the scoped project. Falls back to `OS_PROJECT_DOMAIN_ID`.
- `project_domain_name` (String) Domain name of the scoped project. Falls back to `OS_PROJECT_DOMAIN_NAME`.
- `region` (String) Region to operate in (e.g. `Infra` on CE). Falls back to `OS_REGION_NAME`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Project (tenant) ID to scope to. Falls back to `OS_PROJECT_ID`/`OS_TENANT_ID`.
- `tenant_name` (String) Project (tenant) name to scope to. Falls back to `OS_PROJECT_NAME`/`OS_TENANT_NAME`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Pre-issued Keystone token for token auth. Falls back to `OS_TOKEN`/`OS_AUTH_TOKEN`.
- `user_domain_id` (String) Domain ID that the user belongs to. Falls back to `OS_USER_DOMAIN_ID`.
- `user_domain_name` (String) Domain name that the user belongs to. Falls back to `OS_USER_DOMAIN_NAME`.
- `user_id` (String) User ID for password auth (alternative to `user_name`).
- `user_name` (String) Username for password auth. Falls back to `OS_USERNAME`.
